rules.pattern: \b(?:ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|ETIMEDOUT)\b|connection reset by peer|connection refused|temporary failure in name resolution|server (?:is )?shutting down
rules.reason: Network or service transport failure; restore connectivity before retrying the original run.
Provider rate limit or service outage; no source repair is justified.
